title: About you
description: Participant identifier and recruitment site, then age and sex from questionnaire Section A, About you.

participant_id.title: Participant ID
participant_id.$comment: Source coding: ACH followed by 4 digits. Since the 2024 release the IDs carry a hyphen after the prefix: the letters ACH, a hyphen, then 4 digits (D032); the dictionary text was never updated.

site.title: Recruitment site
site.$comment: Source coding: 01=Northgate; 02=Riverside; 03=Hillcrest. Notes: Leading zero kept.

age.title: Age at interview (years)
age.description: Ages above 85 were top-coded to 85 in the 2024 release, so 85 means 85 or older.
age.$comment: Source coding: integer 18-85; -9 Don't know. Questionnaire A1: 'How old are you?'

sex.title: Sex
sex.$comment: Source coding: 1=Male; 2=Female; -7 Refused. Questionnaire A2: 'INTERVIEWER: RECORD SEX.'
